import os, shutil, stat
srcroot=b'imported'
dstroot=b'converted'
report=b'migration-collision-report.txt'
lines=[]
copied=[]

for dp, dns, fns in os.walk(srcroot):
    rel=os.path.relpath(dp, srcroot)
    relparts=[] if rel==b'.' else rel.split(b'/')
    try:
        outparts=[p.decode('latin-1').encode('utf-8') for p in relparts]
    except UnicodeError as e:
        raise SystemExit('directory-name conversion failed: '+str(e))
    outdir=os.path.join(dstroot,*outparts)
    if os.path.lexists(outdir) and not os.path.isdir(outdir):
        lines.append('COLLISION directory source_hex=%s destination=%s reason=destination-is-not-directory' % (dp.hex(), outdir.decode('utf-8')))
        dns[:] = []
        continue
    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
    for n in sorted(fns):
        sp=os.path.join(dp,n)
        dn=n.decode('latin-1').encode('utf-8')
        tp=os.path.join(outdir,dn)
        if os.path.lexists(tp):
            lines.append('COLLISION source_hex=%s source=%s destination=%s action=preserved-existing-destination-and-source' % (sp.hex(), sp.decode('latin-1'), tp.decode('utf-8')))
            continue
        st=os.lstat(sp)
        if not stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode):
            lines.append('UNSUPPORTED source_hex=%s source=%s action=source-preserved-not-copied' % (sp.hex(), sp.decode('latin-1')))
            continue
        try:
            with open(sp,'rb') as sf, open(tp,'xb') as tf:
                shutil.copyfileobj(sf,tf)
            shutil.copystat(sp,tp,follow_symlinks=False)
        except Exception:
            try: os.unlink(tp)
            except OSError: pass
            raise
        copied.append('COPIED source_hex=%s source=%s destination=%s' % (sp.hex(), sp.decode('latin-1'), tp.decode('utf-8')))
with open(report,'xb') as f:
    f.write(('Filename migration report\n'+'\n'.join(copied+lines)+'\n').encode('utf-8'))
print('\n'.join(copied+lines))
print('REPORT', report.decode())
